name: io.github.armin5872/optiqra-mcp
description: MCP server exposing OptiQra's website audit tools (full SEO/GEO/AEO/performance/accessibility/security analysis, AI-generated fixes, AI insights, and AI key testing) to MCP-compatible clients.

environment_variables.name: OPTIQRA_BASE_URL
environment_variables.description: Base URL of the OptiQra instance to call. Defaults to https://optiqra.vercel.app.

environment_variables.name: OPTIQRA_PROVIDER_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Default AI-provider API key used by the ai-fix/ai-insights/ai-test tools if the caller doesn't pass one.

environment_variables.name: OPTIQRA_TIMEOUT_MS
environment_variables.description: Request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 120000.
